welcome.title: Welcome to LibreFolio
welcome.description: Set up the essentials before you start tracking your portfolio.
welcome.defaultsHint: Language and currency start from your administrator's defaults. You can change them now or later.
welcome.avatarHint: Optional. Your initials are used when no image is selected.
welcome.themeHint: Your current theme preference is kept unchanged.
welcome.completed: Setup saved. You can continue to LibreFolio.
welcome.skipped: Setup skipped. You can replay it later from Settings.

errors.loadDescription: Retry the setup or log out safely.
errors.degraded: Onboarding status could not be refreshed. Your completed setup remains active.
errors.replayStart: Could not start the guide. Try again.
errors.progressUnavailable: Onboarding progress is unavailable. Reload and try again.
errors.complete: Could not finish the guide. Try again.
errors.skip: Could not skip the guide. Try again.

guide.waiting: Waiting for this area to become available…
guide.exploreThenContinue: Explore the indicated control, then continue.
guide.loadProblem: This part of the page didn't load in time. You can continue with the guide.

dashboard.title: Your portfolio at a glance
dashboard.description: The Dashboard is your home for portfolio value, performance, allocation, and data quality.

navigation.title: Find your way around
navigation.description: Use this control to collapse or expand the sidebar on desktop, or open the navigation menu on smaller screens.

transactionsNav.title: Start with your transactions
transactionsNav.description: Transactions contains manual entries and portfolio history.

brokersNav.title: Brokers
brokersNav.description: Open Brokers to configure your accounts.

fxNav.title: FX rates
fxNav.description: Open FX rates to configure currency conversion pairs and their data providers.

assetsNav.title: Assets
assetsNav.description: Open Assets to define the instruments, currencies, and market data used by your portfolio.

toolsNav.title: Tools
toolsNav.description: Tools brings together programs and calculators for exploring scenarios and making more informed financial decisions.

settingsNav.title: Settings
settingsNav.description: Settings contains preferences and lets you replay any guide when needed.

settings.title: Onboarding and guides
settings.description: Replay setup and contextual guides without changing your saved data.
settings.armedToast: {flow} is ready in this browser. Open its feature to start.
settings.armedAtNextTrigger: Ready in this browser: {flow} starts at its next trigger.

upload.title: Upload reports
upload.description: Add one or more broker reports and assign each report to a broker.

select.title: Choose files and parsers
select.description: Select one or more saved reports. Choose the appropriate analysis plugin for each file; exports of one bank uploaded together form a set, analysed as one. When every selection is complete, use the button on the right to continue. Depending on the chosen plugin and extracted data, optional steps may appear to unify assets, correct rows, manage duplicates, or align with the bank.

analyze.title: Analyze extracted data
analyze.description: Run the parsers and review extracted records, notices, and validation results.

assets.title: Unify asset identities
assets.description: Match extracted records that may refer to the same asset.

fix.title: Resolve flagged rows
fix.description: Correct or explicitly keep rows that the parser could not resolve.

duplicates.title: Choose between duplicates
duplicates.description: Decide which overlapping imported rows to retain.

review.title: Review the import
review.description: Select eligible rows and resolve required assets before opening the bulk editor.

bulk.title: Save All writes the transactions
bulk.description: Review and edit prepared transaction drafts, then choose Save All when they are ready.

gapFix.title: Align with the bank
gapFix.description: For a set of exports, compare what LibreFolio will hold with what the bank states, and keep or untick the corrections that close the difference before continuing.

intro.line2: It's great to have you on board.
intro.line3: Here is a quick tour to help you get started.

overview.title: Create a broker
overview.description: This form defines the account that will own transactions and imports.

plugin.title: Choose the default import plugin
plugin.description: The default plugin is preselected when you import reports from this broker.

icon.title: Add a custom icon
icon.description: Choose an image for this broker, or keep the automatic icon derived from its plugin or website.

currencies.title: Choose the currency pair
currencies.description: Select the base and quote currencies that LibreFolio must convert between.

providers.title: Configure rate providers
providers.description: Choose a direct or chained provider route, or keep the pair manual when no automatic source is suitable.

search.title: Search before entering data
search.description: Search online to prefill known identifiers and metadata, or enter the asset manually.

identity.title: Define the asset
identity.description: Review its name, type, quote-base quantity, and currency.

provider.title: Configure the data provider
provider.description: Select the provider, identifier, and parameters, or explicitly keep the asset without a provider.

overview.title: Manage all transactions
overview.description: This page brings together manual entries, imported operations, and the history used to build your portfolio.

add.title: Add one transaction
add.description: Add opens the guided form for a single operation.

import.title: Import multiple operations
import.description: Import reads broker reports and walks you through their review, up to the bulk editor.

columns.title: Filter and organize
columns.description: Use column filters, sorting, and column visibility to find and compare operations.

basics.title: Choose the transaction type
basics.description: The type defines the meaning and structure of the operation.

amounts.title: Complete the required fields
amounts.description: Required fields and valid combinations change according to the selected transaction type.

details.title: Add optional information
details.description: Include any additional details that make the transaction easier to understand and trace.

save.title: Validate in the workspace context
save.description: Validation evaluates this draft together with all other pending operations in the workspace. An error may depend on another draft or on the resulting balance, not only on this form; when available, the message identifies the affected rows and context.

workspace.title: Your transaction workspace
workspace.description: Each row is a draft you can inspect and refine before the final save.

validation.title: Validate and resolve issues
validation.description: Validation highlights incomplete or inconsistent rows and takes you directly to the fields to review.

selection.title: Work on the selection
selection.description: Select rows to edit, clone, reset, link, or remove several drafts together.

save.title: Complete with Save All
save.description: Save All commits the valid drafts. Cancel closes the workspace and preserves the existing portfolio.

overview.title: Your financial accounts
overview.description: Brokers group transactions by account and define ownership, editing permissions, and sharing.

currency.title: Choose the reporting currency
currency.description: The selector recalculates the page summary in the currency you want to compare.

views.title: Cards, table, and account actions
views.description: Switch view to compare accounts, then open one to inspect balances, positions, transactions, and access.

add.title: Add a broker
add.description: Create the account that will receive transactions and imports.

header.title: Broker identity and actions
header.description: The header identifies the account and provides its main edit, sync, sharing, and navigation actions.

overview.title: Overview and cash
overview.description: Overview summarizes value, performance, allocation, and cash balances for this account.

positions.title: Positions and lots
positions.description: Positions explains what the account holds and lets you inspect the lots behind each quantity and cost.

transactions.title: Transactions and imports
transactions.description: This tab filters the account history and provides the path for adding or importing its operations.

info.title: Information and sharing
info.description: Review account metadata and manage who can view or edit this broker.

overview.title: Your currency pairs
overview.description: FX pairs provide the conversion history LibreFolio needs to compare values expressed in different currencies.

filters.title: Filter dates, currencies, and views
filters.description: Narrow the period and currencies, then choose cards or table according to the comparison you need.

sync.title: Update exchange rates
sync.description: Sync requests fresh rates from each pair’s configured provider route.

header.title: Pair and conversion direction
header.description: The header shows base and quote currencies and the actions for returning or swapping direction.

provider.title: Provider route and sync
provider.description: Choose how rates are obtained, then sync when you need to refresh the series.

chart.title: Explore rate history
chart.description: Use the chart, signals, and measurement tools to examine how the exchange rate changed over time.

editor.title: Edit manual observations
editor.description: Open the data editor to review or maintain manual rate points for this pair.

overview.title: Your asset catalogue
overview.description: Assets connect transactions to instruments, currencies, prices, events, and market-data sources.

filters.title: Search and compare assets
filters.description: Filter by name, status, currency, or type and switch between cards and table.

sync.title: Refresh market data
sync.description: Sync requests current values and available history from each asset’s configured source.

add.title: Add an asset
add.description: Search or define a new instrument.

header.title: Asset identity and status
header.description: The header identifies the instrument and gathers its status, navigation, and primary actions.

chart.title: Price history and analysis
chart.description: Use the chart, technical signals, comparison, and measurement tools to explore the asset’s history.

editor.title: Maintain prices and events
editor.description: Open the data editor to review manual prices and the events that affect the asset series.

metadata.title: Identifiers and metadata
metadata.description: Expand metadata to inspect identifiers, classification, currency, and provider configuration.

risk.title: Risk scenarios
risk.description: Open Risk to examine historical measures, stress scenarios, simulations, and portfolio context.
